name: VisionSys AI Inc.
summary: VisionSys AI, Inc. operates as a holding company whose core business involves delivering supplementary educational services in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM), with a particular emphasis on Information Technology (IT). The firm employs a dedicated learning platform that offers a variety of instructional methods, including real-time virtual teaching, conventional in-person classroom sessions, and adaptable online modules. Shao Yun Han founded the company in September 2002, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Beijing, China.
